TechnologyStack.Framework: none (CLI application; no web framework in v1)

dep.name: @opencode-ai/sdk
dep.purpose: Type-safe JS/TS client to drive the headless OpenCode server (opencode serve): create sessions, send prompts, stream events/trace over SSE.

dep.name: opencode
dep.purpose: The agent runtime under test; invoked as a headless server inside each sandbox.

dep.name: pino
dep.purpose: Structured logging with stable marker fields and redaction.

dep.name: @modelcontextprotocol/sdk
dep.purpose: MCP stdio server (M-MCP) exposing the engine as agent-callable tools.

dep.name: zod
dep.purpose: Runtime input-schema validation for MCP tool arguments.

constraint.reason: Runtime and test runner for the tool itself.
OpenCode SDK is pre-1.0 and evolving; pin and isolate behind one adapter module.

discouraged-surface.reason: Built around OpenCode specifically; a universal multi-agent adapter is out of scope for v1.

PreferredAgentStack.discouraged-surface: rivet sandbox-agent / vibekit as a foundational dependency

discouraged-surface.reason: v1 isolation target is local Docker; cloud sandbox providers add accounts, keys, and network dependence.

PreferredAgentStack.discouraged-surface: E2B / Vercel Sandbox / Daytona as the v1 isolation backend

module-level.focus: Fast deterministic unit and contract checks; sandbox and OpenCode dependencies faked/stubbed.

wave-level.focus: Checks only merged surfaces touched by a wave (e.g. engine + sandbox adapter together).

phase-level.focus: Broader integration and regression confidence, including at least one real end-to-end run against a live OpenCode sandbox (gated/optional).

Testing.mocking-policy: Prefer fakes and narrow stubs over broad monkey-patching. The Docker sandbox boundary and the OpenCode SDK boundary are the two seams to fake for deterministic tests.

Observability.redaction: Never log provider API keys, credentials, raw tokens, or full prompt/response payloads flagged sensitive. Redaction applies to both live logs and persisted traces.

AutonomyPolicy.replan-trigger: Missing dependency, contradictory contract, unclear OpenCode SDK / Docker surface, or an undecided open question from requirements.
AutonomyPolicy.checkpoint-requirement: Every completed step must emit assumptions, commands, evidence, and next action.

DeliveryShape.shape: Single-host CLI tool on Bun. Core engine drives OpenCode (opencode serve + @opencode-ai/sdk) inside one Docker container per experiment run, with deny-by-default networking plus an allowlist for the LLM endpoint. CLI is the only interface in v1; the engine is separated so MCP/HTTP interfaces can wrap it later.
DeliveryShape.persistence: Flat JSON under runs/<runId>/{run.json, trace.json, raw.log}; no database in v1 (SQLite deferred).
DeliveryShape.concurrency: Bounded parallelism, default 4, overridable via --concurrency, soft-capped by host resources.
DeliveryShape.credentials: Provider API key injected via env at docker run; redacted in all logs and persisted traces. No credential broker in v1.
DeliveryShape.trace-schema: RunTrace (owned by M-TRACE, independent of the OpenCode SDK): runId, experiment, status, timings, steps[], tokenUsage, finalOutput(text + git diff), error?.
